svg.text: McCzarny recently focused on enhancing his
chromium-daily-digest and dcvis projects. In
chromium-daily-digest, he integrated support
for the OpenCode LLM provider, establishing
fallback workflows to ensure digest generation.
He also refined GitHub Actions for publishing
to GitHub Pages and implemented a concurrency
utility to optimize API requests. Further
improvements to the chromium-daily-digest web
interface include remembering the last read
summary date, adding keyboard navigation
shortcuts, and updating the Gemini AI model.
For the dcvis project, McCzarny introduced a
"Power Scale" tab to compare data center power
consumption against the Bełchatów power
plant. He refined water usage figures to a
specific daily rate and added groundwater
productivity information with map
visualizations. A minor text simplification was
also made in dcvis.
